{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
A '''marine-speeder''' was a type of underwater craft commonplace on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with an aquatic environment, such as [[Praya]]. Several were used on Praya to explore sunken ships and hunt for treasure.<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{C|Tokyo only}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Marine-speeders were mentioned in the post-ride queue video on the [[Tourscan]] for the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] version of the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] ride and was depicted through the use of footage of the Sea Castle optional ending of the former [[Wikipedia:Epcot|Epcot]] attraction [[Wikipedia:Horizons (Epcot)|''Horizons'']].<ref name="YouTube ST queue">{{YouTube|video=VNC_xzE7Y54|text=Tour Scan in ''Star Tours'' at Tokyo Disneyland|channel=@couperin9|name=couperin9}}</ref>
